<main><section id="o" class="panel on"><div class="c hero"><div><div class="k">Business Automation • Windows Systems • AI Tool Developer</div><h1>Josh Floyd</h1><p>I work in IT support and build practical software that simplifies repetitive technical work, improves consistency, and gives operators a clear view of what is happening before, during, and after each task.</p></div><div class="box"><h3>Background</h3><ul><li>4+ years working in IT across field deployment and support.</li><li>Installed and deployed POS systems onsite across 100+ stores.</li><li>Handled service calls, troubleshooting, and issue correction onsite as a Service Tech.</li><li>Now work in Support troubleshooting and correcting issues with POS equipment while also building automation projects with Python, PowerShell, & LLMs to streamline lengthy support tasks, software upgrades, installations, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows.</li></ul></div></div>
<div class="c stats box"><div class="stat"><b>4+</b>Years in IT</div><div class="stat"><b>100+</b>Stores Deployed</div><div class="stat"><b>10+</b>Projects Built</div><div class="stat"><b>Support + Automation</b>Current Focus</div></div>
<div class="c section"><div class="k">// Background</div><h2>Field experience turned into practical automation.</h2><p>I started in the field installing and deploying POS systems onsite and handling service calls when stores needed hands-on support. That experience gave me a direct view of where technical workflows become repetitive, time-consuming, or difficult to manage at scale. I now work in support correcting issues and troubleshooting production environments, while building software projects as a hobby to automate lengthy tasks, software upgrades, installations, diagnostics, and maintenance workflows. For many of these projects I use Python together with large language models (LLMs) to help design, develop, refine, and troubleshoot practical automation tools.</p><div class="points"><div class="point"><b>Field Deployment</b><br>Installed and deployed POS systems onsite</div><div class="point"><b>Service & Support</b><br>Handled service calls and now troubleshoot production issues</div><div class="point"><b>Scale</b><br>100+ store deployments</div><div class="point"><b>Project Development</b><br>Python and LLM-assisted automation development</div></div></div>
<div class="c section"><div class="k">// Featured Work</div><h2>Flagship Projects</h2><p>These featured projects are a sample of the larger tools I have built. Visit Projects to see the full collection.</p><div class="grid flag"><article class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Monthly Bill Calendar"><div><h3>Monthly Bill Calendar</h3><p>A mobile-first budgeting app built around the paycheck that should fund each bill, rather than only the bill’s due date. It supports separate people, recurring bills, paycheck planning, payment history, editable amounts, and shared household use across phones.</p><small>PWA · Supabase · Vercel · Pay-cycle Logic · Shared Mobile Use</small></div></article><article class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Warehouse / QR Inventory Manager"><div><h3>Warehouse / QR Inventory Manager</h3><p>A warehouse inventory tool designed for fast quantity changes without turning the workflow into a full POS system. It combines printable QR labels, phone scanning, USB HID scanner support, Windows desktop use, and shared Google Sheet quantity updates.</p><small>QR · Google Sheets · Apps Script · Windows · USB Scanners</small></div></article><article class="card"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Menusys Management Tool"><div><h3>Menusys Management Tool</h3><p>A centralized Windows utility for comparing MenuSys files, reviewing differences, editing a selected source, importing or exporting configurations, deploying changes to selected systems, verifying results, and handling controlled POS restart workflows from one
